ground_truth.main_content:
Liberty University Online Tuition and Fees

Consistent Tuition Rates for a Decade – Affordable Online Education

Clear Costs, Strong Values – See the Difference at Liberty

As a nonprofit institution, Liberty University strives to keep costs affordable for you. Most of our online tuition rates rank in the top 35% for affordability for 2025 when compared to our leading online competitors, and online undergraduate tuition rates have been frozen for the last 10 years!

Undergraduate Full-time $390 per hour
Part-time $455/hour
Military $250/hour

Graduate Full-time $580 per hour
Part-time $645/hour
Military $290/hour

Seminary Block Rate $2,850 per semester
Graduate Military $2,850/semester
Doctoral Military $2,850/semester

Doctorate Full-time $610 per hour
Part-time $675/hour
Military as low as $375/hour

The above figures are general rates. For more specific program rates, please see the detailed Tuition Rates and Fees for 2025-2026 below.

Full-Time Per Hour Rate

- Undergraduate – $390
- R.N.-B.S.N. and R.N.-B.S.N.-M.S.N. – $330
- B.S.N.-M.S.N. (Dual Degree)¹ – $330
- Master's Programs (unless price otherwise noted) – $580
- M.S. in Biomedical Sciences² – $605
- M.Ed. and M.A. in Teaching Programs³ – $430
- School of Divinity Master's Programs – $2,850 block rate
- School of Divinity D.Min., Th.M., and Ph.D. Programs⁴ – $2,850 block rate
- Ed.S. and Doctorate Programs – $610
- D.N.P. – Psych. Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Post-MSN and Post-BSN)⁵ – $850
- Post-Grad Certificate in Psych Mental Health⁵ – $850
- Military Undergraduate – $250
- Military Master School of Divinity – $2,575 block rate
- Military Graduate – $290
- Military Ed.D.and Ed.S.Programs⁶ – $375
- Military D.Min.: Pastoral Counseling⁶ – $2,800 block rate
- Military School of Divinity Th.M Program – $2,575 block rate
- Military School of Divinity D.Min. Programs – $2.800 block rate
- Military Grad. to Doctoral tuition⁷ – $375
- Technology Fee⁸ – $349 per semester
- Book and Online Content Fees – $636*⁹
- Supplies – $636*
- Course Fees – Per Course

Part-Time Per Hour Rate

- Undergraduate – $455
- R.N.-B.S.N. and R.N.-B.S.N.-M.S.N. – $330
- B.S.N.-M.S.N. (Dual Degree)¹ – $330
- Master's Programs (unless price otherwise noted) – $645
- M.S. in Biomedical Sciences² – $605
- M.Ed. and M.A. in Teaching Programs³ – $645
- School of Divinity Master's Programs – $410
- School of Divinity D.Min, Th.M, and Ph.D. Programs – $410
- Ed.S. and Doctorate Programs – $675
- D.N.P. – Psych. Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Post-MSN and Post-BSN)⁵ – $850
- Post-Grad Certificate in Psych Mental Health⁵ – $850
- Military Undergraduate – $250
- Military Master School of Divinity – $290
- Military Graduate – $290
- Military Ed.D.and Ed.S.Programs⁶ – $375
- Military D.Min.: Pastoral Counseling⁶ – $375
- Military School of Divinity Th.M Program – $290
- Military School of Divinity D.Min. Programs – $375
- Military Grad. to Doctoral tuition⁷ – $375
- Technology Fee⁸ – $349 per semester
- Book and Online Content Fees – $636*⁹
- Supplies – $636*
- Course Fees – Per Course

Special Program Rates

K-12 Online Academy $549/Full-year course

LUOA Discount: Parents who attend Liberty University Online may be eligible to receive a 10% tuition discount for their child to enroll with Liberty University Online Academy.

Willmington School of the Bible $120/Hour

¹ B.S.N.-M.S.N. (Dual Degree) – The B.S.N.-M.S.N. Dual Degree program is formatted in a way in which students enrolled specifically in this program will earn their Bachelor of Science in Nursing and a Master of Science in Nursing concurrently.

² Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences – This program will no longer be accepting new enrollees beginning in Fall 2018.

³ Master of Education and Master of Arts in Teaching Programs – Applicable to School of Education programs only. Does not include School of Behavioral Sciences programs.

⁴ School of Divinity D.Min. and Ph.D. – Rawlings School of Divinity Doctor of Ministry students and Rawlings School of Divinity Ph.D students enrolled between 1 and 6.99 credit hours will be charged the part-time tuition rate of $410 per credit hour for the 2025-2026 academic year. Students enrolled between 7 and 15 credit hours will be charged the block rate of $2,850 for the 2025-2026 academic year.

⁵ Post Graduate Certificates in Psychiatric Mental Health – Beginning Spring 2022, students will pay a flat rate of $1,200 per credit hour. Beginning with the 2025-2026 academic year, the rate is adjusted to $850 per credit hour.

⁶ Military Graduate/Ed.D., Ed.S., D.Min.: Pastoral Counseling Programs – All Doctoral military students enrolled in the programs listed prior will be assessed the $375 rate beginning in the 2025-26 academic year.

⁷ Military Graduate to Doctoral tuition – Beginning in Fall 2020, when you complete a graduate degree through Liberty and continue your studies into specific doctoral programs within 2 academic years of graduation, you will receive a reduced tuition rate of just $375 per credit hour for the 2025-2026 academic year.

⁸ Technology Fee – The Technology Fee is waived for all active military and their spouses starting in the 2025-2026 academic year.

⁹ Book and Online Content – Electronic course materials are provided to online undergraduate students at no cost, since their Inclusive Access fees are waived. Online graduate students have an estimated cost of $636 for textbooks and online content for the 2025-2026 academic year.

2025-2026 Cost of Attendance Allowances

Liberty University Student Financial Services establishes the annual cost of attendance allowances to help students and their families prepare financially for the academic year. The below allowances for online students are estimates and may vary depending on students' individual spending decisions. These allowances are indirect, meaning they are not charged directly to student accounts. These indirect charges are factored into your financial aid budget to ensure you can apply for enough aid for the academic year to assist with educational and living expenses.

- Housing (Off Campus): Full Time $8,140 / Half Time $8,140
- Housing (Off Campus with Parent): Full Time $4,576 / Half Time $4,576
- Food: Full Time $3,210 / Half Time $3,210
- Fees: Full Time $698 / Half Time $698
- Loan Fees (Graduate/Doctoral Students): Full Time $116 / Half Time $116
- Books, Supplies, and Course Materials: Full Time $1,272 / Half Time $636
- Personal/Miscellaneous Expenses: Full Time $3,466 / Half Time $3,466
- Transportation: Full Time $1,756 / Half Time $1,756
